intent: Allow workspace administrators to change member roles without enabling privilege escalation or leaving partial permission state

controlEvidence.authentication: Authenticated session middleware executes before the role mutation handler.
controlEvidence.authorization: Server-side workspace-admin policy is checked against the target workspace.
controlEvidence.least-privilege: Only the role-change permission is granted; ordinary members remain denied.
controlEvidence.audit-log: Successful and rejected privileged role changes emit an audit event.
controlEvidence.input-validation: Requested role is validated against the canonical workspace-role enum.
controlEvidence.transaction-boundary: Role mutation and required owner-count invariant execute within one atomic service boundary.

release.rollbackPlan: Disable the role-update path and deploy the previous known-good version; no migration rollback is required.
release.observabilityPlan: Monitor authorization denials, role-update failures, audit-event failures, and unexpected owner-count changes.
